title: Cognitive dissonance
researchPrompt: Explain why people change their beliefs to match their actions rather than the other way round, and what that predicts about persuasion.
suggestedAngles: Treat the discomfort as the mechanism and belief change as the cheapest way to end it

title: The availability heuristic

suggestedAngles: Frame it as a sensible default that breaks when recall stops tracking frequency

Distinguish availability from base-rate neglect rather than blurring them together

references.label: Tversky & Kahneman (1973) — Availability: A Heuristic for Judging Frequency and Probability
